reason: MultiEmail does use `key={index}` (packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx, patch line 644), but each row is a controlled EmailField with `value={field}`. InputField only keeps its own state for `type=="search"` (packages/ui/components/form/inputs/TextField.tsx:98,142-148), so removing a middle item with splice re-renders the correct values and no row state ends up on the wrong item.
